gates.label: Merchant and account eligibility
gates.detail: Record account-specific acceptance for this exact offer, merchant mode, business and country before enabling payment.

gates.label: Owned rights and deliverable inventory
gates.detail: List every paid file, runtime, licence, third-party input and customer right for this offer; customer data, provider accounts and keys are not inventory.

gates.label: Price, tax and consumer terms
gates.detail: Verify the final price, merchant identity, tax treatment, withdrawal/consent flow, support promise and refund terms for this exact offer.

gates.label: Signed payment event
gates.detail: Prove signature verification, payment-status recheck and rejection of forged, incomplete or replayed events for this offer in an authorised test environment.

gates.label: Idempotent entitlement
gates.detail: Prove the same accepted payment can grant this offer's correct entitlement once and only once without widening account authority.

gates.label: Private delivery
gates.detail: Prove the entitled buyer receives this offer's correct version through an allowlisted private URL without exposing customer prompts or files.

gates.label: Failure, replay and recovery
gates.detail: Test delayed, duplicate, declined and interrupted flows for this offer plus a documented operator recovery path and incident record.

gates.label: Refund and revocation
gates.detail: Prove this offer's refund handling, access revocation where lawful, durable confirmation and reconciliation without claiming unearned revenue.

gates.label: Support, privacy and security
gates.detail: Verify this offer's support ownership, data minimisation, retention, secret isolation, auditability and tested rollback/revocation path.

gates.label: Price, tax and consumer terms

gates.label: Private delivery
